Validation boundary should reject with 422.

DEC-004.title: Accept per-process in-memory caches under multi-worker staleness
DEC-004.rationale: Post list (TTL 300s) and categories/tags (TTL 1800s) caches are process-local TTLCache. docker-compose runs uvicorn --workers 2, so each worker invalidates only its own cache on writes; the other worker serves stale entries bounded by TTL (≤5min posts, ≤30min taxonomies). At this blog's scale the worst-case staleness is cosmetic and self-heals; views/likes never invalidate list cache by design (ordering unchanged).
DEC-004.alternatives_rejected: Redis-backed shared cache (new infra + ops cost, no multi-node deployment yet); single uvicorn worker (loses concurrency for a latent-cosmetic gain); versioned cache keys with a shared clock (still needs Redis to be correct).

EV-033.source: query-count probe on seeded DB + TestClient cache probe (round 18); commit 5750eee
EV-033.title: Performance deep-dive: all read paths N+1-free; posts-list cache serves warm requests at 0 queries
EV-033.content: before_cursor_execute listener on the seeded SQLite DB: get_posts(5)+touch=2 queries, get_post=1, popular(5)=1, related(5)=2, comments list+serialize=2 (flat Comment schema, no relationship access - no N+1); all category/tags eager-loaded via joinedload. Cache probe via TestClient: GET /api/posts?page=1&limit=5 -> request1=2 db-queries (miss), request2/3=0 (TTL hit). No unbounded/N+1 read path found; nothing to fix. Noted for a future optimisation: increment_views performs a write+commit on every page view (write-on-read); fine at this blog scale.

DEC-016.title: Retire the free-text RIL.md ledger; the typed graph is the single engineering-knowledge source
DEC-016.rationale: RIL.md last meaningfully described pre-graph state (2026-07); the .planning/ril graph + ril.py has been authoritative for rounds 1-18 and carries task/issue/evidence/decision provenance the free text lacked. Perf finding recorded as evidence; view write-on-read noted but deliberately not changed (per-view UPDATE is fine at this scale and matches the existing cache decoupling DEC-004).
DEC-016.alternatives_rejected: Keep maintaining RIL.md as a parallel ledger (divergent twin source drifts from graph state - the exact failure mode it already had); delete the legacy content outright (loses historical session context that searchable archive + git history preserve)
